title: Model details and identification
text: metadid assumes every study — regardless design — arises common latent difference--differences () data-generating process. study \(\), outcomes control group follow \[ \begin{pmatrix} Y_{,c,\mathrm{pre}} \\ Y_{,c,\mathrm{post}} \end{pmatrix} \sim \mathcal{N} \left[ \begin{pmatrix} \alpha_i \\ \alpha_i + \beta_i \end{pmatrix} , \begin{pmatrix} \sigma^2_{,c,\mathrm{pre}} & \rho_{,c}\,\sigma_{,c,\mathrm{pre}}\,\sigma_{,c,\mathrm{post}} \\ \rho_{,c}\,\sigma_{,c,\mathrm{pre}}\,\sigma_{,c,\mathrm{post}} & \sigma^2_{,c,\mathrm{post}} \end{pmatrix} \right], \] outcomes treatment group follow \[ \begin{pmatrix} Y_{,t,\mathrm{pre}} \\ Y_{,t,\mathrm{post}} \end{pmatrix} \sim \mathcal{N} \left[ \begin{pmatrix} \alpha_i + \gamma_i \\ \alpha_i + \gamma_i + \beta_i + \theta_i \end{pmatrix} , \begin{pmatrix} \sigma^2_{,t,\mathrm{pre}} & \rho_{,t}\,\sigma_{,t,\mathrm{pre}}\,\sigma_{,t,\mathrm{post}} \\ \rho_{,t}\,\sigma_{,t,\mathrm{pre}}\,\sigma_{,t,\mathrm{post}} & \sigma^2_{,t,\mathrm{post}} \end{pmatrix} \right]. \] parameters : \(\alpha_i\): baseline mean control group \(\beta_i\): time trend shared across groups \(\gamma_i\): baseline difference treatment control groups \(\theta_i\): study-specific treatment effect (estimand) \(\rho_{,c}\), \(\rho_{,t}\): pre/post correlations within group \(\sigma_{,g,t}\): marginal standard deviations key identifying assumption , absent treatment, treatment group followed time trend \(\beta_i\) control group (.e., parallel trends assumption).

Default: cauchy(5). beta_cov Prior covariate regression coefficients (used covariates specified meta_did()).
